why_it_matters: The judged demo must show the partner MCP is used for governed-state retrieval, not merely that the backend writes to MongoDB.
minimum_evidence: MCP server configuration present in repository with credentials excluded.
Agent Builder/Gemini tool path named query_governed_state_via_mongodb_mcp.
Trace log or screenshot showing an MCP aggregate/vector search call.
MCP query includes inheritance_status == INHERITABLE_AFTER_RECEIPT or equivalent filter.
Returned object IDs match the ION inheritance bundle and receipt IDs.
Excluded rejected/deferred/proof-debt object IDs are listed with zero returned overlap.
allowed_operations: run vector search over receipt-cleared objects
forbidden_operations: write accepted state without ION receipt validator
return raw imported chat memory as inherited state
include rejected/deferred/proof-debt objects in next-session context
